turns.content: For N-ethyl-N,2,2-trimethylbutanamide, classify the carbonyl functional group and the nitrogen substitution pattern relevant to BH3/THF reduction.
Using that classification and standard borane selectivity, determine major product A from the first substrate and describe the structural change.
The second substrate is ethyl 1-isopropyl-5-oxopyrrolidine-3-carboxylate. Distinguish its 5-oxo lactam carbonyl from its ethyl ester carbonyl.
Apply the same BH3/THF selectivity to the second substrate and determine major product B, stating which functional group changes.
State the best-supported major product pair A and B.
How strongly is that prediction supported when borane equivalents, temperature, time, and workup are unspecified?
Check that formation of A replaces the tertiary-amide carbonyl by methylene while retaining both nitrogen substituents.
Check that formation of B preferentially reduces the lactam while retaining the ethyl ester, and keep the reaction-condition qualification.
Report A and B together with the confidence qualification.
